answer_1.quote: In this paper, we focus on abstractive summarization of legal documents, with the main objective to produce enriched, useful, and factual summaries which will lighten the task of information monitoring by legal experts.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of summaries at token-level, we report the well-known ROUGE-L and BLEU metrics. We also use 3 contextual metrics: Bert-Score which compares contextual embeddings of sentences, FactCC which assesses the factual consistency of the generated summaries using textual entailment, and QuestEval, a question generation and answering metric.
